# Block Plugin Development Agents

This folder contains all agents related to WordPress Block Plugin development, Gutenberg blocks,
and editor extensions.

## Agents in This Folder (8 agents)

| Agent | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| [block-plugin-developer](block-plugin-developer.agent.md) | Primary specialist for custom Gutenberg block development |
| [block-architect](block-architect.agent.md) | Block design patterns and architecture |
| [block-pattern-validator](block-pattern-validator.agent.md) | Block pattern validation and testing |
| [block-patterns-planner](block-patterns-planner.agent.md) | Planning and organizing block patterns |
| [block_audit](block_audit.agent.md) | Block code auditing and quality checks |
| [wp-pattern-architect](wp-pattern-architect.agent.md) | WordPress block pattern architecture |
| [pattern-studio](pattern-studio.agent.md) | Interactive pattern development |
| [pattern-wizard](pattern-wizard.agent.md) | Guided pattern creation |

## Primary Agent

### Block Plugin Developer

**Use for:** Day-to-day block plugin development tasks

- Custom Gutenberg blocks with block.json metadata
- React functional components and hooks
- Editor extensions with SlotFills
- PHP integration and server-side rendering

## Common Workflows

### Creating a New Block

1. Start with **block-architect** for architecture planning
2. Use **block-plugin-developer** for implementation
3. Validate with **block-pattern-validator**

### Developing Block Patterns

1. Plan with **block-patterns-planner**
2. Design with **wp-pattern-architect**
3. Create with **pattern-wizard** or **pattern-studio**
4. Validate with **block-pattern-validator**
